# Semtech Corporation to Host Data Center Analyst Day on October 15, 2026


*Event to feature strategy overview, technology portfolio and long-term financial objectives from Semtech leadership*


**CAMARILLO, Calif. Oct. 12, 2026 -**[Semtech Corporation](https://www.semtech.com/) (Nasdaq: SMTC), a leading provider of high-performance semiconductors powering AI data center networking and intelligent, connected Internet of Things (“IoT”) devices worldwide, will host an analyst day on Thursday, Oct. 15, 2026, in San Jose, Calif. The event will begin at 9 a.m. PT.


Dr. Hong Hou, president and CEO, Mark Lin, executive vice president and CFO, and other members of the senior leadership team will provide an in-depth review of the Company’s strategy, technology portfolio and long-term financial objectives.


The event will also feature a panel discussion with industry experts, question-and-answer sessions, product demonstrations, and opportunities for in-person attendees to engage with members of Semtech management.


A live webcast of the analyst day presentations, together with the accompanying presentation materials, will be available under “News & Events” on the Investor Relations section of Semtech’s website at[investors.semtech.com](https://investors.semtech.com/) . The presentation materials and presenter remarks are expected to include material business, financial or other information. A replay of the full webcast, together with the accompanying presentation materials, will be available on the website for 90 days following the event.


**About Semtech**


Semtech Corporation (Nasdaq: SMTC) is a leading provider of high-performance semiconductors powering AI data center networking and intelligent, connected IoT devices worldwide.


To learn more about Semtech technology, visit us at[Semtech.com](https://www.semtech.com/) or follow us on[LinkedIn](http://www.linkedin.com/company/semtech) or[X](http://x.com/SemtechCorp) .
